image_description: A black cast-iron skillet sitting on a speckled beige countertop. The pan contains scattered pieces of chopped food (appearing to be vegetables or stuffing). The skillet features a primary long handle extending to the left and a smaller helper handle on the right side. A stovetop burner is visible in the upper background.
